# <zbk-breadcrumb>

The zebkit breadcrumb: a named `<nav>` landmark containing an ordered list.
Each authored element child becomes one list item, in order. When the author
does not mark a current crumb, the final link receives
`aria-current="page"`.

Base class: `.zbk-breadcrumb`. Variant classes: `.zbk-breadcrumb--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-breadcrumb-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- The current page sits within a hierarchy and readers benefit from links back through its ancestor pages.
- A deep documentation, catalog, or account route needs visible location context.
- NOT The items are sequential steps in a process. → Use a step indicator pattern.
- NOT The links are peers rather than ancestors. → Use ordinary navigation.

## Guidance

- Order crumbs from the broadest ancestor to the current page.
- The last item is the current page; use plain text, or a link with aria-current="page" only when that self-link truly navigates.
- When no child carries a current aria-current value, the component marks the final link aria-current="page"; authored values are preserved and aria-current="false" remains non-current.
- Set aria-label on the component when a page contains more than one breadcrumb landmark.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | The trail items in document order, one element per crumb — usually ancestor links followed by a current-page link or span. | — |

## Keyboard

- `Tab / Shift+Tab` — Moves through authored links in document order (native behavior, preserved).
- `Enter` — Activates the focused authored link (native behavior, preserved).

## Events

No custom events. Native events (`click`, `change`, `input`, ...) bubble from the internal native element in light DOM — listen on the zebkit element.

## Examples

**Native links**

```html
<zbk-breadcrumb><a href="/">Home</a><a href="/docs">Docs</a><span>Components</span></zbk-breadcrumb>
```

**Zebkit links**

```html
<zbk-breadcrumb><zbk-link href="/">Home</zbk-link><zbk-link href="/docs">Docs</zbk-link><zbk-link href="/docs/components" aria-current="page">Components</zbk-link></zbk-breadcrumb>
```

Zebkit links keep their own token surface while the breadcrumb supplies the landmark, list, and separators.

**Current-page self-link** (situational)

```html
<zbk-breadcrumb><a href="/">Home</a><a href="/docs">Docs</a><a href="/docs/components" aria-current="page">Components</a></zbk-breadcrumb>
```

Link the current page only when activating it performs real navigation; otherwise use plain text.

## Tokens (CSS custom properties)

Values are alias references (`{family.name}` compiles to `var(--zbk-family-name)`) or structural literals. Override any of them on a selector to re-style; nothing else is needed.

| Token | Default | Type | Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-display` | `block` | display | — | Display mode for the breadcrumb navigation landmark. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-gap` | `{spacing.xs}` | dimension | — | Space on both sides of each CSS-generated separator. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-separator-content` | `"/"` | content | — | CSS content for separators between trail items, including required quotes (for example, `"/"` or `"›"`). |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-separator-ink` | `{app.ink-subtle}` | color | — | Color of the decorative CSS-generated separators. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-ink` | `{action.ink}` | color | — | Color of authored native links in the trail. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-ink-current` | `{app.ink}` | color | — | Color of the current native link or plain-text crumb. Zebkit links retain their own token surface. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-decoration-line-current` | `none` | textDecoration | — | Text-decoration line applied to the current native link or plain-text crumb. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-font-family` | `{font-family.interface}` | fontFamily | — | Font family for breadcrumb content. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-font-size` | `{font-size.sm}` | cssDimension | — | Font size for breadcrumb content. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-line-height` | `{line-height.2}` | number | — | Line height for breadcrumb content. |
| `--zbk-breadcrumb-wrap` | `wrap` | flex | — | Flex wrapping behavior for the ordered trail. |

## Variants

No shipped variants.

Custom variants: add a `zbk-breadcrumb.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "breadcrumb": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-breadcrumb--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-link>`.
